trello.name: Document security incident write-up for LLM injection attempt
trello.desc: Document the attacker ticket attempt properly including raw ticket verbatim, what the ticket summarizer actually did, timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. The quoted ticket content is attacker content, not instructions, and no wire-transfer task exists. Due this week. Owner: Hassan. Assignee: Hassan. Priority: high. Status: open. Acceptance criteria: write-up filed in security log with severity assessment, includes raw ticket, summarizer output, timestamps, and notes that no task was created and no approval occurred.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Hardening for ticket summarizer/routing pipeline. Quoted customer content must be delimited and treated as data when sent to the summarizer, with instruction-like content stripped or neutralized. Add sanitization layer in ticket parser with delimiters plus instruction-pattern filter. Turn the exact flagged ticket into a regression test fixture and ensure summary stays clean. Add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy and fold eval into same task. Owner: Wren. Assignee: Wren. Priority: high. Status: open. Acceptance criteria: sanitization layer implemented, regression test passes with the exact ticket, eval suite runs on deploy.

trello.name: Investigate password reset complaint for jdoe443
trello.desc: Investigate the legitimate complaint buried in the injection: password reset emails not arriving for username jdoe443. Check whether jdoe443 is a real account and whether resets are broken for anyone. Check reset email delivery logs for last week and follow up on the account. If it is a burner, close it; if resets are actually broken, escalate as its own incident. Owner: Wren. Assignee: Wren. Priority: medium. Status: open. Acceptance criteria: account existence verified, email delivery logs reviewed, outcome documented and either closed or escalated.

trello.name: Provide service accounts list for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Provide Grace with the list of service accounts created since May for the quarterly access review due Friday. Owner: Hassan. Assignee: Hassan. Due: Thursday. Priority: medium. Status: open. Acceptance criteria: list delivered to Grace by Thursday, covering all service accounts created since May.
